scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The 'About This Report' section and the Findings priority blocks use first-person voice ('We audited', 'We fetch', 'We score', 'We identify'), but the Executive Summary and Balanced Scorecard narrative paragraphs switch to third-person ('Across the audited set, dkd.de delivers', 'machines can discover and parse dkd.de'), creating a voice mismatch between narrative sections of the same type.
findings.context: We audited ten pages of dkd.de on 27 May 2026 and found a human experience in strong shape.

findings.message: The 'What's Working Well' section opens in third-person ('dkd.de has built a genuinely strong foundations') but the Findings priority blocks immediately following switch to first-person ('We score Discovery Readiness', 'We score MX Stack Completeness'), creating a voice mismatch across sections of the same structural type (body narrative sections).
findings.context: Across the audited set, dkd.de has built a genuinely strong foundations: SEO scores of 94/100

findings.message: The llms-full.txt finding states that whether adding it 'would be worthwhile depends on the full site's content depth, which the audited sample does not yet measure', but the preceding sentence says 'We found no llms-full.txt at dkd.de' without a sample scope qualifier, implying a site-wide absence based only on a root-URL probe of the 10-page sample.
findings.context: We found no llms-full.txt at dkd.de; the endpoint returns a 404 and no reference to it appears in the sitemap

findings.message: The 'Next Steps / Recommended Actions' item 1 refers to 'Catalogue Visibility findings (currently 10/100)', but no finding in the numbered Findings section addresses Catalogue Visibility; the five prioritised findings cover Duplicate IDs, Semantic Structure, Discovery Readiness, MX Stack Completeness, and Structured Data Quality. Asserting Catalogue Visibility as the Priority 1 action conflicts with the structured findings list.
findings.context: Address Priority 1 findings: resolve Catalogue Visibility findings (currently 10/100)
